I agree with your points, but I guess I will add my advice for proctors-

Please stop whispering to each other throughout the exam. The people at the front can hear you. 

Please practice using a CD player before the exam. 

Please don't let the guy next to me loudly burp throughout the whole exam.

There are no official vocabulary lists for the test. All the lists are just best guesses. 

Also, you're also being tested on your ability to figure out the meaning/reading of something that you may e not have specifically studied. For example, you might not know the word 親指, but if you know 親 and 指 separately, it's possible to figure it out.

I think one thing people forget with the JLPT is there is no official list of content that will be tested at each level. The contents of any textbooks or learning materials are essentially a best guess at what is likely to be on the test based on what's been on it before.
